test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

NEVER : PGXGT :: BELOW : DGNQY :: AGAIN : ________
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c862ea9c33a633c54bfcf4c329c66d9a52118504f28cbfbfdf760e12f52cc05.png] 

The logic followed here is:

NEVER : PGXGT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb57941c74855624a3676d3a73e99f862e5da0dabc640585aea3e8632f519856.png] 

BELOW : DGNQY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54020e246acd2078819ef10720c45c403744ee960a0f5526965e47d614986f95.png] 

Similarly, AGAIN : ________

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f314b8d8afa88ef625442255431af9865dde423da434c9908157e198d22071f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**CICKP**".
